fullPassage: Sometimes traditions may change or appear to end because of convenience or changes in taste. For example, to make a pumpkin pie, a cook used to have to first find a pumpkin of suitable size, cut it, peel it, cook it, and mash it, all before combining it with other ingredients and pouring the mixture into a crust. Now, cooks may choose to use canned pumpkin from the supermarket and cut out a great deal of labor and time. Another changing food tradition is that many families no longer make refried beans by cooking them in lard and choose instead to use vegetable shortening. Perhaps this change came about because the family has come to prefer the taste of beans without lard, because concepts of healthy cooking have changed, or because someone in the family has heart disease or high cholesterol.

questions.passage: Sometimes traditions may change or appear to end because of convenience or changes in taste. For example, to make a pumpkin pie, a cook used to have to first find a pumpkin of suitable size, cut it, peel it, cook it, and mash it, all before combining it with other ingredients and pouring the mixture into a crust. Now, cooks may choose to use canned pumpkin from the supermarket and cut out a great deal of labor and time. Another changing food tradition is that many families no longer make refried beans by cooking them in lard and choose instead to use vegetable shortening. Perhaps this change __________ because the family has come to prefer the taste of beans without lard, because concepts of healthy cooking have changed, or because someone in the family has heart disease or high cholesterol.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 이 변화는 가족이 라드 없는 맛을 선호하게 되었기 때문에 '일어났다'.
det.analysis:
❌ ① carried on — 계속하다 (변화의 발생이 아닌 지속)
✅ ② came about — 일어나다, 발생하다 ←정답
❌ ③ broke down — 고장나다, 무너지다 (변화의 발생과 다른 의미)
❌ ④ held back — 억제하다 (변화의 발생 반대)
